_status: ILLUSTRATIVE candidate for the DEMO run. Not the D4 crop set (D4 is open). Values are FAO-56 generic table values, not local calibration.

kc_ini.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, Cereals group Kc ini
kc_ini.region_relevance: Generic; better estimated from wetting interval (FAO-56 Fig. 29/30, Annex 7)

kc_mid.reference: FAO-56 Table 12, 'Sorghum - grain', Kc mid 1.00-1.10 (midpoint used)
kc_mid.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate; adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 62 at run time

kc_end.region_relevance: Sub-humid reference climate; adjusted with FAO-56 eq. 65 because Kc end > 0.45

ini.reference: FAO-56 Table 11, Sorghum, May/June planting, 'USA, Pakis., Med.' row (20/35/40/30)
ini.region_relevance: US row of the table; not site-specific
ini.uncertainty: Printed total is 130 days but the stages sum to 125; the stage values are used and the mismatch is disclosed

max_root_depth_m.region_relevance: Larger value for modelling soil water stress (Table 22 footnote 1)

depletion_fraction_p.reference: FAO-56 Table 22; daily ETc adjustment p = p_table + 0.04(5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8

ky_season.reference: FAO-56 Chapter 8 Table 24 'Seasonal yield response functions from FAO Irrigation and Drainage Paper No. 33' (Doorenbos & Kassam 1979), value 0.9
ky_season.region_relevance: Generic; applied to the whole growing period, water-limited yield only
ky_season.uncertainty: Seasonal Ky only (stage-specific values are not in Table 24); varies with variety and climate
